## Keywords

## 2.1 One account, many services

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- You prove who you are with something you know, have or are.
- With single sign-on (SSO), one sign-in opens many services.
- On a lab computer, sign out and never save your password.
- **Lab task:** Sign in once. How many services open without a second password?
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/sso.png)
:::
::::

## Try it 1 · Accounts and sign-in

a) A code arrives on your phone. Which factor is it: something you know, have or are?
b) You sign in once, and e-mail and e-learning both open. What is this called?
c) You leave your lab desk for one minute. What should you do?

::: {.answer}
a) something you have
b) single sign-on
c) lock the screen (Windows key + L)
:::

## 2.2 The folder tree and paths

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- Storage is a tree of folders and files.
- A path is the full address of a file, from the drive down to the file.
- Two files can have the same name, but never the same path.
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/folder-tree.png)
:::
::::

## Extensions and sizes

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- The extension says which program opens a file, like `.docx` or `.png`.
- Always show extensions: `invoice.pdf.exe` is really a program.
- Each size unit is 1024 times the one before: KB, MB, GB.
- **Lab task:** Turn on file name extensions. What are the size and extension of three files?
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/file-types.png)
:::
::::

## Try it 2 · Paths, types and sizes

a) Two files are both called `cv.docx`. What is always different?
b) A file is called `photo.jpg.exe`. What is it really?
c) A video is 3 GB. How many MB is it?

::: {.answer}
a) their paths
b) a program
c) 3 × 1024 = 3072 MB
:::

## 2.3 Good file names: date, content, version

| Poor name | Better name |
|---|---|
| New Document (3).docx | 2026-10-21_DS_week01_cv_v01.docx |
| final final.pptx | 2026-11-12_pitch-deck_v03.pptx |
| IMG_4821.jpg | 2026-10-21_lab-desk-photo.jpg |

## 2.4 Sync is not backup

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- Sync keeps the same files everywhere, also your mistakes.
- A backup is a separate copy that a mistake does not reach.
- The 3-2-1 rule: 3 copies, 2 kinds of storage, 1 in another place.
- **Lab task:** Delete a test file, then restore it from the recycle bin.
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/sync-backup.png)
:::
::::

## Try it 3–4 · Names and backup

a) Which date format sorts files by date: 21-10-2026 or 2026-10-21?
b) You delete a file on one device, and it is gone on all of them. Why?
c) What does the rule "3 copies, 2 kinds of storage, 1 in another place" ask for?

::: {.answer}
a) 2026-10-21 (year-month-day)
b) The files are synchronized.
c) a backup (the 3-2-1 rule)
:::

## Try it 5 · Sara's project (harder)

The facts: Sara's document `final final (2).docx` is from 5 November 2026. The folder is synced; a USB copy is at home.

a) What is a better name for the document?
b) She deletes the folder on the lab computer by mistake. Where can she restore it first?
c) What is her USB copy at home in the 3-2-1 rule?

::: {.answer}
a) 2026-11-05_DM_notes_v01.docx
b) the cloud recycle bin
c) the copy in another place
:::

## Summary

- You prove who you are with something you know, have or are.
- A path is the full address of a file in the folder tree.
- Show extensions; each size unit is 1024 times the one before.
- Good names have the date (year-month-day) and a version (v01).
- Sync copies your mistakes; a backup does not.
